basis: Defining ectodermal abnormalities affect skin, nails, sweating and teeth; adrenal cyst supplies the endocrine axis.
GSD Ib combines metabolic disease with neutropenic immunodeficiency; hepatic storage and metabolic dysfunction are nearly universal. Renal and intestinal involvement omitted by cap.
Primary brain calcification with movement, cerebellar and cognitive dysfunction; localized calcification does not establish systemic metabolic disease.
Precursor B-cell leukemia/lymphoma; blood-cell malignancy and lymphoma mechanism apply.
Leukodystrophy, cerebellar abnormalities and developmental impairment define disease; sensorineural hearing loss in 1/2. Oculomotor signs do not establish intrinsic eye damage.
Defining severe developmental impairment, abnormal skeletal maturation/muscle fibres and chronic intestinal dysfunction; constipation reported in 80-99%.
Mitochondrial disease with defining ophthalmoplegia, retinopathy and heart block; cerebellar ataxia in 30-79% is diagnostic. Muscle and hearing involvement omitted by cap.
Amyloid deposition is localized to skin; this cutaneous disorder does not imply systemic amyloidosis or systemic metabolic dysfunction.
Cerebellar disease and axonal peripheral neuropathy define SCA43; weakness and distal amyotrophy reflect denervation rather than primary muscle disease.
Congenital structural underdevelopment of the stomach causes severe feeding intolerance; associated anomalies are variable.
Cytopenic immunodeficiency; hearing loss reported in 80-99% and optic abnormalities/visual loss in 30-79%. Secondary infections and malignancies excluded.
Defined by small-intestinal inflammation; the umbrella does not establish an infectious or autoimmune cause.
Localized benign breast lesions; associated diabetes is a separate disease, and an autoimmune mechanism is not established.
Bacterial infection causes adrenal hemorrhage and insufficiency with defining disseminated intravascular coagulation; shock alone does not establish cardiac damage.
Isolated spermatogenic failure and male infertility affect reproductive function without established endocrine dysfunction.
Infarction directly destroys posterior myocardial tissue.
Muscle fatty replacement/atrophy, inflammatory dermatitis and intestinal lymphangiectasia occur in at least 50% of reported cases; developmental delay omitted by cap.
Tumor arises from hormone-producing Leydig cells, the endocrine compartment of the gonad; hormonal symptoms are not required.
Defined by multinodular thyroid disease; associated DICER1 tumors and colorectal polyposis are separately diagnosed conditions, not direct organ involvement.
Tryptophan-handling disorder with characteristic intellectual disability and ataxia; short stature and photosensitivity alone do not establish additional tissue damage.
Inherited melanin biosynthesis defect defines skin/hair hypopigmentation and ocular developmental abnormalities with visual impairment.
Infiltrating adipose neoplasm of deep soft tissue, typically involving skeletal muscle; prominent vascularity alone does not establish vascular disease.
The umbrella predominantly comprises muscular dystrophies and structural protein myopathies; neural or cardiac involvement is not shared across most subtypes.
Carcinoma originates in colorectal glandular epithelium; metastatic sites are not defining organ involvement.
Mature T-cell lymphoma defines hematologic and lymphoma mechanism axes; no individual extranodal organ is established as commonly damaged.
